goal: Iske baad aap kisi parameter ko default value de sakte hain, bata sakte hain ke kin parameters ko default mil sakti hai, aur andaza laga sakte hain ke jab caller kam arguments de to function ko kaun si values milti hain.
warmup: Aap rickshaw book karte hain. Driver kehta hai: 'Rs 30 per km aur Rs 50 booking.' Aap har dafa is par baat nahi karte. Yeh aam sa sauda hai. Agar aap kuch na kahein to wahi aam sauda lagu hota hai. Agar aap kahein 'Aaj Rs 40 per km', to sirf wahi hissa badalta hai. Default argument bhi bilkul aise hi kaam karta hai. Function ke paas parameter ki ek aam value hoti hai. Caller usay chhor sakta hai aur aam value use ho jati hai, ya nayi value de kar usay badal sakta hai.
definition: Default argument woh value hai jo function prototype mein likhi jati hai. Agar caller us parameter ki value na de, to compiler default use karta hai. Agar caller value de de, to caller ki value use hoti hai. Defaults ki wajah se ek hi function ko chhote tareeqe se (kam arguments) ya poore tareeqe se (tamam arguments) call kiya ja sakta hai.
howItWorks: Trace aur stack ko dekhein. Caller ke arguments parameters mein LEFT se rakhe jate hain. Jo parameters bach jate hain woh apni default values le lete hain. Isi liye defaults sab se RIGHT wale parameters par hone chahiye. Agar beech wale parameter ka default ho aur aakhri ka na ho, to compiler ko pata hi nahi chalega ke aakhri ko kaise bharna hai. Default sirf ek dafa, prototype mein likha jata hai, kyunke compiler call dekhne se pehle prototype parhta hai. Usay definition mein dobara likhna error hai. Aap beech ka argument skip bhi nahi kar sakte: teesri value dene ke liye doosri value bhi deni parti hai. Ehtiyat karein jab function overload bhi ho: default ki wajah se do overloads ek hi call se match kar sakte hain (agla lesson dekhein).
